# Bundled libraries

Stored here so the board needs no CDN and works offline. Update by downloading the same files of a newer version.
The license texts are in `licenses/` (they have to travel with the files).

| File | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `codemirror/*` | CodeMirror 5.65.16 (core, markdown mode, dialog, searchcursor, vim) | cdnjs | MIT |
| `marked.min.js` | marked 12.0.2 | jsDelivr | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify 3.2.4 | cdnjs | Apache 2.0 or MPL 2.0 |
| `fonts/`, `fonts.css` | Inter, JetBrains Mono, Source Serif 4, Pixelify Sans, Quicksand, Pacifico (latin and latin-ext) | Google Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://openfontlicense.org |
